digest.component_or_area: plan review gate — R1 candidate validation
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone/strip driver, pure metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main

Live gate replay batch (~450 runs: ~200 coarse sweep + ~50×3 candidate + ~50×3 current) was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in d8a5 (change #798, MERGED), which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost
Recall contamination is removed via recall-stripped clone (store copy with REVIEW_RESULT.json deleted) and baseline drift is guarded by material-fingerprint verification
History-based baseline mining is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed after impact_model_version bump stranded the history

False-positive control evaluation pairs candidate and current gates fresh (N=3, two-level median) against a 50-ticket over-sampled pool to isolate true candidate effect, with acceptance rule: new_blocking_median ≤ max(3, null_floor) AND new_advisory_median_delta ≤ 1
